name: collect wood
log: Dry branches crack beneath your feet as you search for fuel.
Brittle twigs litter the ground under the trees.
You detach sound dead branches from a fallen trunk.
An armful of dry wood is gathered from the forest floor.
You assemble a bundle of light, well-seasoned branches.
The quantity of fallen wood is sufficient for all you can carry.
Loose bark and twigs should serve admirably as kindling.
The dry outer bark separates readily in long strips.
You collect slender branches and twigs, light enough to carry.
_note: no exploring needed: the forest floor is full of deadwood
